verdict.reasons: Core conditions are met with high confidence. The main commercial product is correctly identified as the white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll, matching the authoritative reference. Branding is authentic, readable, and aligned with owner-approved captions, including the required watermark. The installed flat drip-tape laterals and neutral seedlings align well with the agromorphic article intent and technical evidence. No people, fake logos, collage panels, or wrong product families are present. Minor advisory notes include slight visual proximity between the package and installed lines, which does not constitute a hardware defect.

focused_physical_review.reason: The package sits on bare soil on the far left, separated from the irrigation lines by a broad, uninterrupted gap of soil. There are no lines touching or crossing the package footprint, no distinct loose coils on the soil (only the required roll), and no protruding strips or tape tails visible on the carton's sides or base.
